messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — I'm about to flip the autoscale/burst feature flag for eu-west to test queueing fallback during peak. Keeping the canary tiny (1%) and max_concurrency guardrail at 80 per-node. Leaving this here for async 👍

maria: Thanks — what audience are you targeting for the 1%? internal-only or prod canary? :eyes:

alex: internal prod traffic only (team accounts + a tiny slice of organic). Not external customers. Plan: 30m smoke, watch tail latency and error-rate, rollback if p95 latency > 450ms or 5xx rate jumps > 0.2%.

sam: Quick nit — are we toggling queueing=true as well, or is burst handling without queueing for the first canary?
alex: Enabling queueing=true for the canary. Reason: we want to see graceful degraded latency versus hard rejects. Also we set queue_max_wait=150ms for canary.
jin: Can you paste the exact flag payload you're using so I can validate the rollout service config?
alex: pasted below (deploy-bot will also show):

```json
{
  "flag": "autoscale_burst_eu",
  "scope": "eu-west",
  "audience": "internal_prod_slice",
  "percentage": 1,
  "overrides": {
    "queueing": true,
    "queue_max_wait_ms": 150,
    "max_concurrency_per_node": 80
  },
  "rollback_conditions": {
    "p95_latency_ms": 450,
    "error_rate_percent": 0.2
  }
}
```

deploy-bot: deploy request received for autoscale_burst_eu by alex at 1893456789. Dry-run validated.

maria: OK — I reviewed and the guardrail metrics are in the dashboard (link: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/autoscale/eu-west). I'll watch the p95 + 4xx/5xx. Ping me if you want me to abort.
sam: FYI I'm going to add a temporary alert in PagerDuty with a low threshold for early detection (p95 > 350ms). Will remove after canary.
jin: One more ask — make sure the canary isn't applied to the dedicated pools (customer-dedicated-*). We only want shared-hosted nodes.
alex: Good catch. Added exclusion to the rollout: exclude: ["customer-dedicated-*"]. Updated payload now. Re-deploying the flag.
deploy-bot: rollout started: autoscale_burst_eu -> audience internal_prod_slice (1%) ; excludes customer-dedicated-* ; queueing=true ; queue_max_wait=150ms ; max_concurrency=80.
maria: :white_check_mark: Observability team on standby.
sam: Alert created and pinned. Also leaving a CR comment about adding a small note to the runbook about the queue_max_wait experiment.
alex: Will follow up with a short postmortem template if we need to rollback. For now monitoring only. Thanks all.
